title: Claim (a Claims copy row as a pull writes it)
description: One line of norm/claims.jsonl: a row of the Claims copy as plain values. The agent writes Agent tags, Agent notes, Agent confidence and Agent reasons; the editor writes the verified tags (a relation to the Rulebook copy, resolved here to tag names), Review status, Why wrong and Challenged tags notes. A claim is decided when review_status is Reviewed; any other state has no decision. A script never writes the four editor fields (hard rule 1).

geo_id.description: The claim's identity in Geo; the key of the row.

agent_notes.description: Two lines: the tags that apply or no tags; then how many tags wait for an editor (or that nothing waits), whether the agent disagrees with the editor, what was not checked and the edition.

agent_confidence.description: The lowest confidence among the tags the agent judged on the claim.

agent_reasons.description: One line per judged tag: "<Tag>: <reason> · <rule cited> · <k> of <n> runs agree".

verified_tags.description: Claim quality tags — verified, as tag names.

challenged_notes.description: The editor's words; a line that starts with a tag name and a colon belongs to that tag.
